status: User-agreed 13 metric families. Development source-coverage references, not runtime facts or independent gold answers.
coordinate_convention: PDF pages one-based; table rows and columns zero-based.

statutory_npat.name: Statutory net profit after tax
statutory_npat.basis: Statutory profit attributable to owners, including discontinued operations. Continuing-only alternatives must be explicitly labelled.

cash_profit.name: Cash profit / cash earnings
cash_profit.basis: Continuing operations, each issuer's disclosed cash basis; not a standardised cross-bank accounting measure.

operating_income.name: Total / net operating income
operating_income.basis: Group cash-basis continuing operations; keep original and restated comparatives separate.

operating_expenses.name: Operating expenses
operating_expenses.basis: Group cash-basis continuing operations. CBA total operating expenses, including restructuring/notable items, not its underlying expense row.

credit_impairment.name: Credit impairment charge
credit_impairment.basis: Group cash-basis loan/credit impairment expense, not a credit-loss ratio.

nim.name: Net interest margin
nim.basis: Group cash-basis NIM, with each bank's definition; not half-year NIM.

basic_cash_eps.name: Basic cash earnings per share
basic_cash_eps.basis: Continuing operations, cash basis, basic not diluted; cents per share.

dividend_per_share.name: Full-year dividend per share
dividend_per_share.basis: Full-year dividend for ordinary shareholders, not final dividend alone.

gross_loans.name: Gross loans and acceptances
gross_loans.basis: Issuer-disclosed group gross loans and acceptances, not net loans or a narrower advances series.

customer_deposits.name: Customer deposits
customer_deposits.basis: Issuer-disclosed customer funding deposits, not total deposits and other public borrowings. Report vintage must be retained.

total_assets.name: Total assets
total_assets.basis: Consolidated Group balance sheet, not parent Company or average assets.

cet1.name: CET1 capital ratio
cet1.basis: Reported APRA regulatory capital basis; NAB explicitly Level 2 Group. Not pro-forma or internationally comparable alternative.

lcr.name: Liquidity Coverage Ratio
lcr.basis: Quarterly average for the quarter ending at financial year-end, not an annual average or spot observation.

caveats: 52 original-vintage anchors establish value presence, not correctness of all answers, every definition or every comparison.

CBA FY2024 funding-table deposits are 834,259; the FY2025 table's FY2024 comparative is 851,682. Preserve both vintages. The reason has not been established by this coverage check.
NAB loan and deposit anchors are rounded AUD billions. Converting units cannot recover unreported precision.
CBA ends 30 June and NAB ends 30 September. Same FY labels do not mean identical calendar periods.
Profit and EPS scope variants are not interchangeable. Ask for clarification or show labelled alternatives.
Extraction review flags and independent holdout remain open. These are not independent gold references.
